description.value: Monashee Spirits is a small family-run craft distillery and cocktail lounge on Revelstoke's main Mackenzie Avenue strip, hand-distilling award-winning spirits with local ingredients and pure mountain spring water. Their Ethos Gin was named Best in Class Gin in Canada and Canadian Artisan Spirit of the Year 2019, and the bar was ranked #42 in Canada's 100 Best Bars. They also boast one of the largest whisky collections in Canada with over 700 bottles.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website loaded successfully and confirms an active craft distillery and cocktail bar at 307 Mackenzie Avenue, Revelstoke, BC. The about page explicitly states 'We don't have beer, wine, food' (with only free popcorn as a complimentary snack), ruling out food-related amenities; curb-side delivery is offered for bottled spirits purchases. No bike parking, washrooms, water, or other cyclist-specific amenities are mentioned anywhere on the site; OSM opening hours differ notably from the website's posted hours, which is flagged as a concern.
concerns: OSM opening hours (Tu-Th 16:00-22:00; Fr-Sa 13:00-23:00) differ significantly from website hours (Monday closed, Tuesday–Sunday approximately 13:00–23:00); website hours should be treated as more current.
Phone number (250) 814-7299 appears on website but is absent from OSM tags; added from website.
OSM spells street as 'MacKenzie Avenue'; website consistently spells it 'Mackenzie Avenue' — minor discrepancy noted.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible craft distillery and cocktail bar in Revelstoke's town centre — a natural stop for touring cyclists seeking local spirits or a drink.
